
'''Hikawa Shrine''' may refer to:

* [[Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)]], the main Shinto shrine in Saitama Prefecture, which has several branch shrines, including:
''' [[Hikawa Shrine (Akasaka)]], in Akasaka, Minato, Tokyo
''' [[Hikawa Shrine (Kawagoe)]]

'''Hikawa Shrine''' (氷川神社) is a [[kami (Shinto)]] shrine dedicated to Susanoo-no-Mikoto as its primary deity. It is central to the Hikawa Faith, with over 200 shrines bearing the Hikawa name, primarily located along the Arakawa River (Kantō) in the former Musashi Province, which includes present-day Saitama Prefecture and Tokyo. Including shrines without the Hikawa name, there are over 260 associated shrines, some of which are written as "簸川神社."
